Analyse the training examples:
Example 1:
Grid size 16x8.
Column 0 is all 0s.
Teal (7) is background.
Teal lines/rows with 8s:
Row 1: [0, 8, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7] -> length 1 of 8s
Row 3: [0, 8, 8, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7] -> length 2 of 8s
Row 5: [0, 8, 7...] -> length 1 of 8s
Row 7: [0, 8, 8...] -> length 2 of 8s
Row 9: [0, 8, 8...] -> length 2 of 8s
Row 11: [0, 8, 7...] -> length 1 of 8s
Row 13: [0, 8, 7...] -> length 1 of 8s

In the output:
Row 1: 8 of length 1 becomes 8 of length 2? [0, 8, 8, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7]
Row 3: 8 of length 2 disappeared, and at the other end (opposite side of 0): [0, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 0, 0] -> 2 zeros appear at columns 6, 7!
Row 5: 8 of length 1 becomes length 2!
Row 7: 8 of length 2 disappeared, replaced by [..., 0, 0] at the other end!
Row 9: 8 of length 2 disappeared, replaced by [..., 0, 0] at the other end!
Row 11: 8 of length 1 becomes length 2!
Row 13: 8 of length 1 becomes length 2!

Wait, why did length 1 become length 2, and length 2 become zeros at the opposite side?
Wait, what is the wall of zeros?
In Example 1, column 0 is 0s (wall of 0s).
There are "bars" of 8 extending from the wall of 0s.
Some bars have length 1, some have length 2.
Wait! Why length 2? Notice: length 2 was the longer bars.
Did the length 1 bars get extended to length 2 (the length of the other bars)?
And the length 2 bars moved/projected to the opposite wall as 0s (color of the base wall)?
Wait, look at Example 2:
Grid size 8x16.
Row 7 is all 0s (the wall of 0s at the bottom).
Bars of 8 extending upwards from row 7:
Col 0: length 2 (rows 5, 6)
Col 2: length 2 (rows 5, 6)
Col 5: length 2 (rows 5, 6)
Col 10: length 1 (row 6)
Col 12: length 1 (row 6)
Col 14: length 2 (rows 5, 6)

In the output of Example 2:
Col 10, 12: length 1 became length 2 of 8s! (rows 5, 6 are now 8)
Col 0, 2, 5, 14: the length 2 bars disappeared from rows 5, 6, and instead appear at the top wall (rows 0, 1) as 0s!
Length 2 of 0s at the opposite wall!

Wait! In both examples:
There are two lengths of bars: length 1 and length 2.
- The shorter bars (length 1) get extended to length 2 (in color 8)!
- The longer bars (length 2) get cleared and projected onto the opposite wall as color 0 of length 2!

Wait, why length 2 specifically? Because the two lengths present in the input are 1 and 2!
Wait, or is it:
Bars of length 1 become length 2.
Bars of length 2 become 0s on the opposite side.
Let's check test input when it appears!An input grid is ready. Please proceed with the test input.
